Upload or update an artifact for an environment.

The artifact value is stored in file storage (local/GCS) and metadata
is stored in the database. If the artifact already exists, it will be
overwritten.

Args:
    project_id: Project ID
    env_id: Environment ID
    key: Artifact key (unique within the environment)
    file: The file to upload
    tags: Optional JSON string of tags (e.g., '{"type": "output", "source": "terraform"}')
